messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-4521 detected — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/chat/generate (hosted). Paging primary.
alex (primary): I’m on it. Seeing error spike ~02:14 UTC, 5xxs up to ~17% of requests over 5m. Logs show downstream runtime OOM and worker restarts.
maya (secondary): @alex good catch. Any customer-impact estimate? Which regions?
alex (primary): Impact mostly us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Estimated affected requests ~18% for chat endpoints, embeddings mostly fine. Customer-facing symptoms: slow responses and intermittent 504s.
samir (platform): Noted. I can check node metrics and GPU memory pressure. Suspect a quantized model variant pushed to prod yesterday.
alex (primary): Quick checklist I'm running now:
- confirm pod restarts: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l svc=runtime -o wide`
- tail logs: `kubectl logs -n inference <pod> -c runtime --since=10m`
- check node OOMs: `journalctl -u kubelet | grep -i oom`
- check rolling deploys: `kubectl rollout history deploy/runtime`

samir (platform): running those now. FYI there's a recent config that enables aggressive KV-cache prefetching for long-context workloads.
maya (secondary): If KV prefetch is the culprit we can flip the feature flag in the runtime config map to reduce prefetch window. Where’s the runbook for this path?
alex (primary): Runbook links:
- general HTTP 5xx: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/http-5xx
- runtime OOM & restarts: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-oom
- model rollback & canary: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollbacks

samir (platform): I found repeated `OOMKilled` on runtime pods and high vGPU memory use. Prefetch window adds ~20% memory in some sequences.
alex (primary): Immediate mitigations (quick pointers):
1) Disable KV prefetch flag (short-term) — rollout to runtime config-map
2) Scale up replica count on dedicated pools for affected zones (`kubectl scale deploy/runtime --replicas=6 -n inference`) — increases headroom
3) If scaling not enough, roll back to previous model build (see model-rollbacks runbook)
4) Enable fallback route to smaller model variant for hosted API (config in router /routes)

maya (secondary): I can flip the flag and coordinate a small scale-up. @samir can you prepare a quick rollback artifact in case?
samir (platform): On it. Making a tag of the prior model and validating startup locally.

alex (primary): I’ll make the customer impact note: contacting SEs for known large customers. Also posting summary to #customer-impact.
maya (secondary): Steps I’m taking now:
- patch config-map to set `kv_prefetch_window: 0` (apply canary to 2 pods first)
- scale runtime from 3->6 in us-east-1
- watch error rate and p95 latency for 10m

alex (primary): Example patch command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap runtime-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/kv_prefetch_window","value":"0"}]'
```
Then restart 2 pods in canary group:
```
kubectl delete pod -n inference -l svc=runtime,canary=true --wait=false
```

samir (platform): Canary pods up, memory stable on two nodes. Monitoring metrics. Error rate decreased ~6% so far (from 17% -> 11%).
maya (secondary): After canary looks good, I'll roll patch to remaining pods and scale across regions.
alex (primary): Customer note: initial mitigation shows partial improvement. Will escalate to SE + CSMs for affected accounts. Tagging :eyes: on top customers.
ops-rotations: Please prepare to update the incident status in pagerduty (we moved to partial mitigation).

maya (secondary): Rolling full rollout now to remaining pods in us-east and eu-west. Watchlists:
- 5xx rate
- p95 latency
- GPU mem usage

samir (platform): Full rollout completed. GPU memory stabilized, pod OOMs stopped. 5xx rate back down to ~2.3% (baseline ~1.8%).

alex (primary): Nice. Customer impact: reduced to transient and localized; proceed with postmortem. I'm going to hand primary to @maya in 15m — leaving checklist and runbook links in thread. Final handoff notes:
- state: mitigated, watch for regressions for next 2 hours
- action items: samir to prepare rollback artifact and configuration PR to reduce default prefetch, eng-runtime to add auto-scaling buffer for peak windows
- comms: post update to #customer-impact and update PD status

maya (secondary): Taking over in 15. Acknowledge and will monitor for 2h. Reach me @maya if anything spikes.
alex (primary): Thanks — handing off now. :phone: :thumbsup:
